extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: You MUST import and use BOTH audioManager AND speechManager. Import speechManager from '../../../lib/sim-engine/speech'. Use audioManager.play() for sound effects (valid: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint). Use speechManager.speak() for spoken teaching slide narration, challenge questions, correct/incorrect feedback, and hints. The game must teach: (1) Revision of matter — matter is anything that takes up space and has weight. Three states: solid (definite shape and volume — stone, book, brick), liquid (definite volume but no definite shape, takes container shape — water, milk, oil), gas (no definite shape or volume, fills any space — air, cooking gas, steam). (2) Properties of air — air is invisible, has mass/weight, takes up space, can be compressed, exerts pressure, moves (wind). Air supports life (breathing) and burning. (3) Composition of air — air is a mixture: nitrogen 78 percent (largest part), oxygen 21 percent (needed for breathing and burning), carbon dioxide 0.04 percent (used by plants for photosynthesis), other gases like argon, helium, water vapour about 1 percent. (4) Breathing and respiration — breathing is the physical process of taking in air (inhalation) and giving out air (exhalation). Inhaled air has more oxygen, exhaled air has more carbon dioxide. Respiration is the chemical process inside cells where oxygen breaks down food to release energy. Both breathing and burning use oxygen and release carbon dioxide. Deep breathing fills lungs fully and is good for health. Misconceptions: 'air is mostly oxygen' (air is mostly NITROGEN at 78 percent, oxygen is only 21 percent), 'air has no weight' (air has mass — a balloon filled with air weighs more than an empty one), 'breathing and respiration are the same' (breathing is the physical movement of air in and out of lungs, respiration is the chemical process inside cells that releases energy from food), 'liquids have a definite shape' (liquids take the SHAPE of their container — only solids have a definite shape), 'gas has a definite volume' (gas fills any container completely — it has no definite shape or volume). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function MatterAirGame), NOT export default. Export interface MatterAirGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void. Use double quotes for ALL strings containing apostrophes. Use 'currentChallenge' as variable name, NOT 'challenge'. Auto-hint timer MUST be exactly 10000ms.
